# PolicyHandle

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/onnx/`](../folders/src-onnx.md)
> **Source:** [`src/onnx/policy_runner.h`](../../../src/onnx/policy_runner.h)

## Summary

The ONNX policy a world's PolicySys runs.

## Description

Inserted (insert_or_assign) into a world registry by ModelWatcherSys on the host, or by tests. Replacing it swaps the policy at the next Act tick. Worlds with the same ModelWatcher spec share one PolicyRunner; PolicyRunner::run is called concurrently from parallel worlds (Ort::Session::Run is thread-safe). A null runner or a missing handle makes PolicySys do nothing.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `runner` | `std::shared_ptr<PolicyRunner>` | nullptr | Loaded, layout-validated ONNX Runtime session. |
| `deterministic` | `bool` | true | true: output deterministic_continuous_actions (mean); false: continuous_actions (mean + noise). |
